summary: A collection of 14 comms from The Division universe, scraped from the Fandom wiki hub page. 14 entries include full audio transcripts; 0 have known map locations.

claims.text: Comm "Crackdown": Anderson calls his Lieutenant to question resource allocation
Comm "Reaching Out": A defector tries to negotiate with some True Sons after a firefight
Comm "The Informant": Anderson gives a promotion to Major Kernel after he uncovers an assassination plot
Comm "Resource Management": True Sons defectors try to secure additional resources for Operation Rising Echo
Comm "Groveling": True Sons soldiers discuss Anderson's lack of transparency about the failed pact with Black Tusk
Comm "Surveillance": A couple True Sons security guards cycle through surveillance footage
Comm "Uprising": A True Sons Lieutenant interrogates a suspected defector about mysterious graffiti calling for an uprising
Comm "Full House": A group of True Sons raid a building where suspected defectors are holding an ominous meeting

Comm "Encounter": Kelso describes an impactful encounter with a True Sons defector
Comm "Last Chance": A Black Tusk Lieutenant acting on behalf of Nat orders Anderson to pull out of East Mall
Comm "Get Out": Adkins calls an old flame and warns her about the uprising
Comm "Silence": Anderson decides to take drastic measures to make a group of captured defectors talk
